command_path_binding: Validate operation_id against route, target_ref against the path entity, and actor/account against authenticated ingress; bind the canonical request and expected_revision to the idempotency key. Outcome unknown remains the original accepted command, polled via EL-OP-008; it is never a success status.
http_binding_rule: Proposed exact paths reuse existing gateway/domain owners; native source admission must detect conflicts and map existing operations, not create duplicate authority. Versioned binding updates require registry/render regeneration before acceptance. These routes are not asserted deployed.
list_and_status_contract: All lists are account-scoped, cursor-paginated and snapshot-versioned; expose pending, unsupported, stale, suspended and service-error separately. Cohort study output links LearningHypothesis and EvidenceAssessment and the full trial ledger; original and corrected revisions remain distinct.
